'''DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Martin Akesson]] wrote that he won it, beating [[Aldrin Long]] in the final.<ref name="tr-d163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-world-championships-by-martin-akessond163/ world-championships-by-martin-akesson], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 January 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025134508/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-world-championships-by-martin-akessond163/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dc99sw22_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525001947/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99sw22_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101003044/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (Progressive Sealed Deck)
* '''Format:''' [[Progressive Sealed Deck]]<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Thursday 11 November 1999, 2 p.m.–8 p.m.; Friday 12 November 1999, 1 p.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 13 November 1999, 7 a.m.–1 p.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia

A Saturday heat is on the schedule. A Saturday score sheet is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Friday heat ==

[[Alex Alcalde]] directed the Friday heat, which started at 1 p.m., with 68 command cards and help from [[Charles Lund]]. During the final confrontation a player told him that the top Dark Side deck looked "a little too good". Alcalde found 10 Premiere rares in it, more than an OTSD can hold, and after talking with Decipher staff disqualified the player, who is not named.<ref name="cec-dc4">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.4], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030108/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html Internet Archive]</ref>
